Bombay HC Clerk Test Glitches Spark Protest, Demand for Re-test

Candidates protested in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, over alleged technical glitches during the Bombay High Court clerk typing test. Abhijit Dipke of CJP joined the demonstration, claiming several candidates were unfairly declared failed due to system failures. Protesters are demanding the test be conducted again. The issues reported included malfunctioning computer systems, with some candidates being disqualified within minutes.
